purpose: Owner-requested replacement for the homepage and Our Story atelier photograph
prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: finished editorial photograph for the Our Story section of MAISON ÉLAN, a fictional premium minimalist fashion website. Create one original portrait photograph, aspect ratio 4:5. Art direction: a quiet, architectural contemporary tailoring atelier photographed for an independent luxury fashion magazine. Main subject: a beautifully sculptural, unbranded warm taupe wool coat with notched lapels on a simple linen-covered dress form, the entire garment and its shoulders clearly visible, including hem, with generous breathing room. Position this subject centrally in the middle 70 percent so responsive cropping keeps it intact. Restrained foreground: the edge of a pale oak cutting table holds one precisely folded ivory wool length, a small charcoal fabric swatch and a single closed pair of brushed steel tailor's shears. Background: warm chalk plaster wall, tall translucent ivory curtain at the left, subtle deep doorway at the right. Strong composition through soft verticals, foreground depth and elegant fabric drape, no clutter. Lighting: luminous oblique morning window light across the wool, gentle long shadows, dimensional soft contrast, warm ivory highlights and rich charcoal accents, neutral taupe rather than orange. Medium-format editorial realism, exceptional believable woven fibres and seam details, natural tonal rolloff, fine restrained film grain, intentional fashion-house art direction. Sophisticated, tactile and contemporary; avoid vintage rustic workshop styling, showroom gloss, stock-photo staging or CGI plasticity. No people, no hands, no faces, no words, no lettering, no logos, no watermarks, no border, no collage. Image only, not a webpage mockup.
processing: Metadata-free RGB quality-94 WebP master. Proportional 320/480/720/960px WebP derivatives use quality 78. Original atelier master and derivatives preserved.
